mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent FEDFUNDS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or UNRATE increase does not correlate with subsequent GDP contraction.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or GDPC1 decline does not correlate with subsequent earnings downgrades.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% MoM signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or INDPRO decline does not correlate with subsequent earnings revisions.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the CPIAUCSL is above 2% YoY, the market anticipates aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or the combination of low FEDFUNDS and high CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent rate hikes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs per month for three consecutive months signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or PAYEMS increase does not correlate with subsequent GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% MoM signals increased consumer confidence and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances despite positive signal, or HOUST increase does not correlate with subsequent consumer spending growth.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the GDP (GDPC1) is contracting, the market anticipates a recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or the combination of high FEDFUNDS and contracting GDPC1 does not correlate with subsequent recession.
